claims.statement: Termind has native TFM macOS and TFI iPhone/iPad apps over shared frameworks, with separate test, widget and macOS MCP bridge products; native UI/lifecycle remain app-owned. Project settings use Swift 6, complete strict concurrency, warnings as errors, approachable concurrency and MainActor isolation; bridge and benchmark targets use nonisolated isolation.

A safe change must preserve the lifetime split: app services are shared, desktop workspaces are window-local, mobile navigation is scene-local, and mobile live workspaces and saved descriptors belong to persistent UIKit scene sessions, not a single cross-window workspace pool.

ArchitectureBoundaryTests enforce root-specific import restrictions: five non-presentation shared frameworks cannot import app targets or AppKit/UIKit/IOKit/ServiceManagement, while Presentation has a separate rule allowing SwiftUI but excluding app targets, native UI, storage and implementation modules; shared Application cannot import Infrastructure, Persistence or SwiftData, and scanned SwiftData model declarations belong in Persistence.

AgentKit supplies the host-neutral runtime as a remote package; Termind owns and registers SSH/SFTP tools through TermindAgentTools. Dependency updates keep Xcode requirements and resolved pins aligned; AgentKit, libssh2-spm and libtailscale-spm are not maintenance submodules and have no dependency gitlinks to initialize or update.

Routine Xcode validation uses -onlyUsePackageVersionsFromResolvedFile, TFM/TFI entrypoints, strict Swift formatting and Scripts/check-localization.py. AgentKit, libssh2-spm and libtailscale-spm are remote dependencies, not submodules; native builds require no maintenance-submodule initialization. The libssh2 requirement is upToNextMinorVersion from 2.0.3-termind-4.
macOS tests that show windows or take focus are intentionally opt-in through `TEST_RUNNER_TERMIND_WINDOW_TESTS=1` or `TERMIND_WINDOW_TESTS=1`, so routine validation remains headless.

MobileAppModel pauses background services when all scenes background. Background expiration suspends workspaces, stops forwarding, pauses transfers and expires Assistant work; active scenes resume eligible monitoring, memory, workspaces, sync and metrics.

Live connections alone no longer trigger window-close or application-wide quit confirmation. Native window vetoes and unsaved terminal-theme protection remain; quit saves theme edits, asks before discarding still-unsaved themes, then rechecks pending SFTP edits with cancellation before shutdown. Debug tests do not terminate on last-window close; otherwise menu-bar metrics preferences and running metrics decide.

Mac app termination fences new Assistant work, cancels and drains conversations and pending preparations before agent resource closure, while stopping MCP and transfers; AppKit receives one termination reply on cleanup completion or after a three-second fallback.

Mobile scene-local navigation and Assistant presentation sit over shared app services and native-session-owned workspace sessions; eligible scene-keyed descriptors are disk-backed, while live workspace ownership also survives scene disconnect/background until discard or orphan reconciliation.
Mobile key-window integration tests require TEST_RUNNER_TERMIND_MOBILE_UI_TESTS=1, disabled parallel testing and a narrow TFITests filter.

App copy changes require completed simplified and traditional Chinese translations and localization validation; AppLanguageTests covers language behavior. Parent guidance requires a production website build and visual English/Chinese checks, but native catalog and commerce policy tests do not verify external website copy, deployed routes or RevenueCat dashboard content. The StoreKit fixture is for manual development; live products, trial eligibility and purchase/restore behavior require RevenueCat and App Store Sandbox validation separately.

The Debug macOS test host launches the real app but suppresses automatic main and external-auth windows unless TERMIND_WINDOW_TESTS=1 or a screenshot demo is active; it disables main-scene restoration during tests and screenshot demos, while focus-changing tests independently require a visible-window trait opt-in.

RootView registers each window with the shared AppModel and publishes a focused window value while its own WindowModel owns navigation and workspaces; switching destinations preserves mounted workspace native views.

App-facing copy belongs in TermindPresentation/Strings and manually maintained catalogs. Catalog edits require normalization, AppStrings validation and python3 Scripts/check-localization.py; the current validator checks zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, de and fr coverage, format arguments, plurals, spacing and canonical catalog formatting.

MobileAdaptiveLayoutTests is serialized and gates native-window cases with requiresKeyWindow, leaving pure width logic enabled by default; affected UIKit cases need explicit mobile UI opt-in, nonparallel execution and a narrow filter.

Selecting a saved mobile descriptor publishes a live workspace in the owning workspace session before connecting; another scene's activity link routes to that owner rather than creating a duplicate connection, and repeated selection in the owner reuses the same workspace.
Xcode requires remote AgentKit through upToNextMinorVersion from 4.0.0, and Package.resolved records 4.0.0; resolved-only app builds consume the remote pin rather than sibling working-tree edits.

Legacy mobile.workspaces.v1 and mobile.recentlyClosed.v2 defaults are retired without migration; mobile.restorableWorkspaces.v1 stores scene-keyed saved descriptors, including ordinary connection intent rather than only resumable transports or SSH persistence. Transient external connections are excluded. Cold launch loads descriptors without live connections; recently closed records remain process-local.

Mobile backgrounding or scene removal preserves workspace ownership. Native-session reconciliation saves the complete descriptor handoff before transferring live objects without reconnecting; save failure preserves source ownership. A late discard removes recovered workspaces from a window used in this process, whereas unbound cold-launch records remain recoverable when UIKit discards their archived sessions.
Mobile one-shot commands and initial paths are carried by live workspace construction rather than restoration descriptors; restoring eligible descriptors must not replay those startup inputs.

SSH Security Key registration and signing is owned by the Termind SSH integration, with focused Vault metadata, WebAuthn and interaction-policy tests for its persistence and authentication boundaries.

ConnectionJourney owns shared connection progress and authentication/host-key checkpoint state; ConnectionJourneyRouteView draws the shared route while desktop and mobile views supply native surrounding controls. ConnectionJourneyTests checks state, and MobileMetricsJourneyTests exercises native authentication presentation with a test sampler rather than live SSH.

Desktop MetricsJourneyRenderingTests is visible-window-gated; MobileMetricsJourneyTests is serialized and key-window-gated. Native fixtures exercise inline authentication/navigation/layout and restore temporary windows; they are not quiet model-only checks or default coverage without opt-in.

The desktop delegate's three-second fallback begins after quit confirmations, when shutdown is started, and bounds the once-only AppKit quit reply rather than completion of the asynchronous shutdown task.

Ghostty comes directly from Lakr233/libghostty-spm without a local Ghostty maintenance submodule or Termind fork binary/override-workspace prerequisite. The current upToNextMinorVersion requirement starts at 2.2.2026101502; host adapter checks do not establish upstream pointer/gesture internals.
Mobile SSH, Mosh, Eternal Terminal and Telnet search binds query and presentation to the workspace-owned TerminalFindController, while SFTP search binds directly to sftpChannel.query.
Mobile terminal search remains attached to stable chrome outside connection-state branches, and terminal surfaces remain mounted but hidden and noninteractive beneath connection-journey gates.

The live local schema is V59. Migration validation should open historical stores and verify data after reopening rather than hard-code the latest schema into unrelated tests; HostIconTests includes V53 upgrade and artwork persistence after reopen.
Wire versions are independent per record kind rather than SwiftData schema versions. Host writes V8, HostGroup V7, SSHKey V3, Snippet V2, WorkspaceTemplate V2 and Metrics V2.

Missing local Firebase or RevenueCat configuration leaves those services unconfigured and Crashlytics symbol upload disabled by default without bypassing Pro access checks; local service configuration files are Git-ignored.
